A “Setu” coin with a bull on the obverse: Otu mkpụrụ ego "Setu" nwere oke ehi na nhụsianya. Okwu Setu - àkwà mmiri na Lanka, na Rameswaram - pụtara na mkpụrụ ego nke ndị ọchịchị Tamil oge ochie nke oge ochie nke alaeze Jaffna; ehi couchant, Shiva's Nandi, bụ ngwaọrụ ha na-ahụkarị.
A burial urn of the kind that made Adich: Ụdị olili ozu nke mere Adichanallur ama ama. A na-etinye ndị nwụrụ anwụ - ma ọ bụ ọkpụkpụ ha gbakọtara - n'ime ihe ndị dị otú ahụ na ngwongwo ili ma lie ya n'ala nke dị n'elu Thamirabarani. The urns bụ kpọmkwem njikọ na முதுமக்கள் தாழி nke Sangam uri.
A catalogue of the coins issued by the C: Katalọgụ nke mkpụrụ ego ndị eze Chera, Chola, na Pandya wepụtara, na ihe nnọchianya eze ha nke ụta, agụ, na azụ.
A ceramic vessel from Adichanallur. Smal: Ụgbọ mmiri seramiiki sitere na Adichanallur. A na-etinye obere ite ndị dị otú a n'ime ma ọ bụ n'akụkụ ebe a na-eli ozu, ikekwe na-ejide nri, mmiri ma ọ bụ onyinye maka ndị nwụrụ anwụ - nhụta nke nkwenye Iron Age na njem gafere ọnwụ.
A chariot for a creeper, a shawl for a p: Ụgbọ ịnyịnya maka onye na-akpụ akpụ, shawl maka oke ọkụ, mkpụrụ na-enye ndụ maka onye na-ede uri: onyinye kacha ewu ewu nke ndị na-azụ ahịa na-ele anya na-abaghị uru, nke ahụ bụkwa isi okwu ha. Kodai madam bụ mmesapụ aka nke ukwuu nke na onye na-enye anaghị agbakọ iji onyinye ahụ - ọmịiko metụtara anụmanụ, osisi na mmụta.
A Chera coin in the collection of the Na: Otu mkpụrụ ego Chera dị na nchịkọta ihe ngosi nka nke Napier, Thiruvananthapuram. Mkpụrụ ego Chera na-ebu ụta na akụ, akara nke usoro eze, na ọtụtụ ihe atụ mbụ sitere na Karur, Chera center na Amaravathi.
A chieftain of the Ay line in the southe: Otu onye isi ahịrị Ay nke dị na ndịda ugwu ugwu nke Podiyil (Pothigai). Omenala a ma ama na-ekwu maka inye chi dị iche iche uwe dị oké ọnụ ahịa, nke a na-akpọkarị Shiva - inye ihe dị ka nraranye yana mmesapụ aka.
A chieftain of the Malaiyaman lineage, o: Otu onye isi nke agbụrụ Malaiyaman, nke obodo dị gburugburu Mullur na Tirukkoyilur, chetara maka onyinye ya nye ndị na-ede uri na ndị niile bịakwutere ya. Ọnọdụ ya n’etiti ndị mmadụ asaa ahụ na-egosi na a na-atụle nsọpụrụ onye ọchịchị site n’inye ihe dị ka ókèala ya.
A Chola coin carrying Pandya royal insig: Otu mkpụrụ ego Chola bu akara ngosi eze Pandya. Mgbe ndị Cholas wetara obodo Pandya n'okpuru ọchịchị ha, ha debere azụ Pandya n'akụkụ agụ nke ha - ihe nnọchianya nke mmeri dara na ọla.
A city where literature, royal patronage: Obodo ebe akwụkwọ, nkwado eze, okpukperechi na ndụ obodo zukọrọ ihe dị ka puku afọ abụọ.
A coin of Kulottunga Chola bearing the t: Otu mkpụrụ ego nke Kulottunga Chola na-ebu aha "Malai Nadu konda Chola" - Chola nke weere ugwu ugwu, ya bụ, ala Chera. Ndị eze Chola kwusara mmeri ha n'utu aha a tụrụ n'elu mkpụrụ ego ha nakwa nke e denyere n'ihe odide ha.
A coin of Kulottunga I (1070–1120 CE), w: Otu mkpụrụ ego nke Kulottunga I (1070-1120 OA), onye jikọtara ahịrị Chola na Eastern Chalukya wee chịa otu n'ime ọchịchị Chola kacha ogologo na nke kacha nwee ọganihu. Mkpụrụ ego ya na-aga n'ihu na ụdị Chola guzosiri ike na aha ya na Nagari.
A coin of Rajaraja I. His copper coins o: Otu mkpụrụ ego nke Rajaraja I. Mkpụrụ ego ọla kọpa ya nke ụdị eze na-eguzo na oche, ewepụtara mgbe o meriri n'ebe ugwu Sri Lanka, na-ekesa n'akụkụ abụọ nke oké osimiri ma na-eṅomi ruo ọtụtụ narị afọ.
A coin of the Jaffna kingdom showing a h: Otu mkpụrụ ego nke alaeze Jaffna na-egosi ịnyịnya nwere azụ. Ndị eze Tamil nke Jaffna (narị afọ nke 13–17) nyere mkpụrụ ego n'ọdịnala ndị South India, ihe ncheta maka njikọ chiri anya n'ofe Palk Strait.
A coin of the Kongu Cheras, the Chera li: Otu mkpụrụ ego nke Kongu Cheras, akara Chera nke chịrị obodo Kongu nke dị n'ebe ọdịda anyanwụ Tamil mpaghara (gburugburu Coimbatore, Erode na Karur nke ugbu a) - otu mpaghara ahụ nke na-eweta nnukwu ego nke mkpụrụ ego Rom.
A crowned, moustached figure in profile,: Okpueze nwere okpueze na profaịlụ, na-eyi jaket mara mma na ịchafụ na-asọ asọ, na-ebuli ndị ọrụ nwere nku. A na-esere ihu na aka n'ahịrị ojii dị mma na ala na-acha odo odo ma na-asa uwe mwụda na ocher, pink na green - ihe osise dị ka ihe ọmụmụ nke uwe ụlọikpe na eserese ụlọ nsọ.
A detail of the painted ceiling of the J: Nkọwa nke elu ụlọ a na-ese n'ọgba nke Jain dị na Sittanavasal: lotuss pink na-emeghe n'etiti paịlị ndụ ndụ, anụmanụ na-agafe na mmiri na ihe osise na-achịkọta ifuru. A na-agụkarị ọdọ mmiri ahụ dị ka lotus moat nke samavasarana, nzukọ eluigwe ebe Jain Tirthankara na-ekwusa ozi ọma, ya na ndị na-ekwesị ntụkwasị obi na-ezukọta okooko osisi na-enye.
A funerary vessel from the burial cairns: Ụgbọ mmiri nke si n'ebe a na-eli ozu nke ugwu Nilgiri, kpuchie mkpuchi ya na ihe oyiyi. Ndị na-egwupụta ihe na narị afọ nke iri na itoolu nke Nilgiri cairn hụrụ ọtụtụ mkpuchi ndị dị otú ahụ na ndị mmadụ, anụmanụ na ndị na-agba ịnyịnya - obere ihe nkiri na ụrọ nke nwere ike igosi ndụ na ọnọdụ nke ndị nwụrụ anwụ.
A garland of about a hundred and fifty a: Otu ihe dị ka amaokwu akam narị na iri ise sitere na Kanimethaviyar, ụfọdụ iri atọ maka nke ọ bụla n'ime ala ise ahụ.
A gold coin of Rajaraja I (985–1014 CE),: Otu mkpụrụ ego ọla edo nke Rajaraja I (985–1014 OA), onye wuru nnukwu ụlọ nsọ na Thanjavur. Ọ na-egosi akara ngosi eze nke Chola nke ọma: agụ nọ ọdụ n'akụkụ azụ Pandya abụọ, n'okpuru parasol nke ọbụbụeze, na aha eze na Nagari - Chola na-ekwu na ọ na-achị ndịda.
A gold half-kahavanu of Virarajendra Cho: Ọkara-kahavanu ọla edo nke Virarajendra Chola (1063-1070 OA). Kahavanu (nke sitere na kahapana) bụ okpukpe ọla edo nke Sri Lanka, na ọla edo Chola kụrụ n'ụkpụrụ a na-egosipụta oge Chola na-achị agwaetiti ahụ.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiya: uri ndu nke Idylls iri nke Kadiyalur Uruthirankannanar. A na-edu otu bard nwere nnukwu yazh gaa Thondaiman Ilanthiraiyan nke Kanchi; N'ụzọ ahụ, uri ahụ na-ese ihe nkiri ndị mara mma nke obodo nta, ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri, na ndị mmadụ.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Mudath: Abụ nduzi nke Idylls iri nke Mudathama Kanniyar. Ogwe ịgba egwu (porunar) nke enwetala ụgwọ ọrụ nke ukwuu na-eduzi otu bard ibe onye eze Chola na-emesapụ aka Karikal Valavan.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Nallur: uri ndu nke Idylls iri nke Nallur Nathathanar. Otu bard nke na-akpọ obere yazh (harp) na-eduga onye ọzọ na onye isi Nalliyakkodan, na-akọwa ihe isi ike nke bards dara ogbenye na ịhụnanya nke onye na-akwado mmesapụ aka.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Perunk: Abụ nduzi nke Idylls iri nke Perunkausikanar. Ndị na-eme ihe nkiri na-awagharị awagharị (koothar) na-eduzi onye isi Nannan; a na-eme uri a maka ijide ọtụtụ ụda ugwu.
A large storage jar associated with Adic: Nnukwu ite nchekwa jikọtara ya na Adichanallur. Obere ite nwere ọka, mmiri na ihe ndị ọzọ; N'ebe a na-eli ozu, arịa ndị dị otú a nwekwara ike bụrụ ihe mgbaba. Okwu ahụ bụ́ “dolio” na-echeta dolium, bụ́ nnukwu ite ihe nchekwa nke ụwa ndị Rom.
A large, round-bellied funerary urn from: Nnukwu olili ozu gbara gburugburu si Adichanallur. Urn dị otú a nwere ike ịdị ogologo karịa nwatakịrị, na-eme ka ha chọọ nkà dị ukwuu: ndị na-ede uri Sangam na-agwa onye na-emepụta ihe dị ka கலம்செய் கோவே - "O eze n'etiti ọkpụite".
A lead coin from Andipatti bearing a leg: Otu mkpụrụ ego ndu sitere na Andipatti na-ebu akụkọ na Tamil-Brahmi. E wezụga ndị eze atọ ahụ ekpuchiri okpueze, ndị isi obodo nke ọgbọ Sangam nyere mkpụrụ ego n’ụdị ozu na ọla kọpa, akụkọ akụkọ Tamil-Brahmi n’ime ha na-enyekwa aka n’itinye ndị ọchịchị a aha.
A line drawing of the vimana and a pilla: Ihe osise ahịrị nke vimana na ụlọ nzukọ nwere ogidi nke Temple Brihadisvara.
A love poem of the Ten Idylls by Kapilar: Abụ ịhụnanya nke Idylls Iri nke Kapilar, nke edobere n'ugwu (kurinji). Omenala kwuru na e dere ya iji kuziere eze ugwu ịma mma uri ịhụnanya Tamil; ọ kpọrọ aha ifuru iri itoolu na itoolu aha.
A modern artist’s imagining of a busy ha: Echiche nke onye na-ese ihe nke oge a banyere ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri na-ekwo ekwo nke ụgbọ mmiri, ahịa na ụlọ elu, mgbe nkọwa na Silappatikaram na Pattinappalai gasịrị. Ọ bụghị ihe àmà na-egosi otú obodo ahụ si yie.
A modern sketch imagining ships and buil: Ihe osise ọgbara ọhụrụ na-echepụta ụgbọ mmiri na ụlọ dị n'ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri oge ochie. Dị ka nrụgharị ọ bụla nke Puhar, ọ na-akọwa nkọwa akwụkwọ; a maghị nhazi zuru oke nke ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri.
A name linked with Nedunalvadai and Tiru: Aha ejikọtara ya na Nedunalvadai na Tirumurukarruppatai na Idylls iri - n'agbanyeghị na ọ nwere ike ịbụ nke ihe karịrị otu onye na-ede uri n'ofe oge dị iche iche. Akụkọ mgbe e mesịrị na-ekwu banyere ịjụ ikpe ya banyere abụ ọbụna Shiva n'ụlọ ikpe Pandya: ihe nnọchianya nke obi ike ọgụgụ isi, ọ bụghị ihe omume akụkọ ihe mere eme.
A palm-leaf manuscript from the museum’s: Ihe odide nkwụ sitere na mkpokọta ihe ngosi nka.
A Pandya coin of the “massa” type. Massa: Otu mkpụrụ ego Pandya nke ụdị “massa”. Massa bụ aha e nyere mkpụrụ ego ọla kọpa nke oge ochie na-egosi ihe kwụ ọtọ n'otu akụkụ na onye nọ ọdụ n'akụkụ nke ọzọ - ụdị nke ndị Cholas gbasaa na Pandyas na ndị eze Sri Lanka na-aga n'ihu.
A Pandya coin showing a standing king wi: Otu mkpụrụ ego Pandya na-egosi eze guzoro ọtọ nwere akara azụ. Ndị Pandyas weghaara ọdịdị nke onye ọchịchị guzoro ọtọ, nke ego ọla kọpa Chola mere nke ọma, mgbe ike ha tụgharịrị na narị afọ nke 13.
A Pandya coin with the twin fish and a b: Otu mkpụrụ ego Pandya nwere azụ ejima na oke ehi. Azụ jikọtara ọnụ ghọrọ ihe nnọchianya Pandya na-adịgide adịgide, nke a kpụrụ n'ọkọlọtọ Madurai nke abụ ndị ahụ ma tụọ ya na mkpụrụ ego ihe karịrị otu puku afọ.
A pipeline of terracotta rings, set one: Otu ọkpọkọ nke mgbanaka terracotta, nke edobere n'elu ibe ya n'ọkwa anọ, kpughere na ngwupụta Korkai. Ọkpụkpọ ụrọ agbanyụ ọkụ na olulu mmiri mgbanaka dị ka nke a na-ebu ma na-agbapụta mmiri n'ime obodo Tamil nke oge ochie - akụkụ nke injinia kwa ụbọchị nke ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri na-ekwo ekwo.
A poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiyalur Ur: Abụ nke Idyll Iri nke Kadiyalur Uruthirankannanar, na-eto eze Chola Karikal Valavan na obodo ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri ya nke Kaveripoompattinam (Puhar), ya na ụgbọ mmiri, ahịa na ememme ya.
A poem of the Ten Idylls by Nakkeerar. D: Abụ nke Idylls iri nke Nakkeerar. N'ime ogologo oge oyi na-atụ n'ebe ugwu nke oyi, otu nwanyị na-achọsi ike maka di ya ebe eze na-elekọta ndị agha ya merụrụ ahụ n'ogige agha.
A portrait coin of the Chera king Kuttuv: Mkpụrụ ego eserese nke eze Chera Kuttuvan Kotai, na-akpọ ya na Tamil-Brahmi. Site na mkpụrụ ego Makkotai, okwu ọlaọcha ndị a na-adịghị ahụkebe - ikekwe sitere na mkpụrụ ego ihe osise Rome na-abịa site na ahia - so na mkpụrụ ego India mbụ iji gosi ihu onye ọchịchị.
A potsherd inscribed in Tamil-Brahmi, fo: Otu ite ite e dere na Tamil-Brahmi, nke a chọtara na Tissamaharama nke dị n'ebe ndịda Sri Lanka ma dee ya n'ihe dị ka narị afọ nke abụọ TOA. Ide ihe na Tamil n'ite dị anya site na mpaghara Tamil na-egosi ndị ahịa Tamil na-arụ ọrụ n'ofe oke osimiri n'oge mbụ akụkọ ihe mere eme.
A rare book from the first decades of Ta: Akwụkwọ a na-adịghị ahụkebe sitere na iri afọ mbụ nke mbipụta Tamil, mgbe a na-edobe ederede ochie echekwara na akwụkwọ nkwụ n'ụdị na nke mbụ.
A rare volume digitised from CICT’s arch: E depụtara mpịakọta dị ụkọ site na ebe nchekwa CICT ma chekwaa maka ọmụmụ ihe. Ndị na-ahụ maka ihe ngosi nka ga-agbakwunye nkọwa katalọgụ zuru ezu.
A Sangam-age Chola coin with a tiger and: Mkpụrụ ego Chola nke Sangam nke nwere agụ na elephant. Mkpụrụ ego Chola mbụ, nke ka ukwuu nke ọla kọpa, n'etiti agụ - otu akara ahụ nke Cholas nke alaeze ukwu ga-ebu otu puku afọ ka e mesịrị. Uraiur na Kaveripoompattinam bụ nnukwu ebe etiti ha.
A Sangam-age Pandya coin, typically a sm: Mkpụrụ ego Pandya nke Sangam nke dị afọ, nke na-adịkarị obere square ọla kọpa nwere enyí n'otu akụkụ yana azụ a mara mma n'akụkụ nke ọzọ. Mkpụrụ ego ndị dị otú ahụ na-ekesa na na gburugburu Madurai, isi obodo Pandya na-eme ememe na Maduraikkanchi.
A scholarly study of government, adminis: Ọmụmụ ihe gbasara gọọmentị, nchịkwa, na ndụ ọha na obodo Tamil nke afọ Sangam.
A second coin of the Kongu Cheras. Compa: Mkpụrụ ego nke abụọ nke Kongu Cheras. Tụlee ihe abụọ a: mkpụrụ ego ndị a kụrụ aka na-adịgasị iche na iku, eyi na ịkpụ, na ndịiche dị otú ahụ na-enyere ndị na-ahụ maka ọnụọgụgụ aka idozi okwu na ịchọpụta ogologo oge mkpụrụ ego nọrọ na mgbasa.
A second image of the four-armed, seated: Ihe onyonyo nke abụọ nke ogwe aka anọ, nọ ọdụ Ganesha. Tụlee nha ya, ihe ịchọ mma na ntụgharị nke ogwe ya na nke mbụ: n'ime akwụkwọ nkekọrịta nke Silpa Sastras, onye ọ bụla na-ese ihe na ụlọ ọrụ na-ahapụ aka ya.
A selection drawn from the Thirukkural,: Nhọrọ nke sitere na Thirukkural, na-anakọta di na nwunye echefu echefu maka ndị na-agụ akwụkwọ.
A separate photographing of the opening: Foto dị iche iche nke akwụkwọ mmeghe nke ngwugwu 579 D, Maduraikkanchi.
Onye nsọ Shaiva, aka jikọtara n'ofufe. Ndị eze Chola na-asọpụrụ ndị Nayanmar iri isii na atọ, ndị Sekkizhar kwuru ndụ ha na Periya Puranam, na ihe oyiyi ọla ha ka e dobere n'ụlọ arụsị ma na-ebuga n'usoro ememe.
A sherd illustrated in Vimala Begley’s 1: Otu sherd gosipụtara na ọmụmụ Vimala Begley nke 1983 gbasara mkpakọrịta nwoke na nwaanyị Arikamedu. N'ịtụleghachi n'ígwé ndị a gwupụtara, Begley rụrụ ụka na mmezi ahụ malitere na etiti narị afọ nke atọ TOA - tupu Mortimer Wheeler tụrụ aro - ya na kọntaktị Mediterranean na njedebe narị afọ nke abụọ TOA. Ụbọchị ya ka bụ nkọwa nke ndị ọkà mmụta.
A sherd of an urn found in 2004, decorat: Otu shei nke urn achọtara na 2004, chọọ ya mma na enyemaka etinyere ya na onyonyo nwanyị kwụ ọtọ n'etiti ihe ndị a na-agụkarị dị ka ahịhịa paddy, mgbada, kreenu na agụ iyi. Ndị ọkà mmụta ahụwo na ya bụ chi nwanyị nke mbụ - ụfọdụ, dị ka ihe nkiri ahụ na-ekwu, onye bu ụzọ nke Kotravai, chi nwanyị agha nke uri Sangam. Ọ bụ otu n'ime onyonyo ihe atụ na-adịghị ahụkebe nke Iron Age Tamil Nadu.
A short illustrated guide for visitors:: Ntuzi aka dị mkpirikpi maka ndị ọbịa: ihe abụ Sangam bụ, otu esi achịkọta ha, yana otu abụ akam na puram na mpaghara ala ise si arụ ọrụ.
A silver kasu of Rajendra Chola combinin: Kasu ọlaọcha nke Rajendra Chola na-ejikọta akara eze - agụ Chola na azụ Pandya na ụta Chera.
